items.exampleEn: After college, he lived like a nomad, working in a different city every year.
items.exampleZh: 大學畢業後，他過著遊牧般的生活，每年都在不同的城市工作。

items.exampleEn: The islanders depend on fishing and tourism.
items.exampleZh: 島民靠捕魚和觀光維生。

items.exampleEn: Excuse me, madam, is this your bag?
items.exampleZh: 不好意思，女士，這是您的包包嗎？

items.exampleEn: The old play is about a family that cannot afford a dowry for their daughter.
items.exampleZh: 這齣老戲講的是一戶人家付不起女兒嫁妝的故事。

items.exampleEn: This valentine was hidden in her old diary for twenty years.
items.exampleZh: 這張情人節卡片在她的舊日記裡藏了二十年。

items.exampleEn: Working in a hotel suits him because he is so sociable.
items.exampleZh: 在飯店工作很適合他，因為他很愛交際。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, a filial son carries his father across the river.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一個孝順的兒子背著父親過河。

items.exampleEn: We are spending the holiday at my brother-in-law's farm.
items.exampleZh: 我們要在我姻親兄弟的農場度假。

items.sentenceEn: Some families still follow the old custom of giving a dowry.
items.sentenceZh: 有些家庭仍遵循準備嫁妝的老習俗。

items.audioEn: Madam, your taxi is waiting outside the hotel.
items.audioZh: 女士，您的計程車在飯店外面等您。
items.questionZh: 說話者告訴這位女士什麼事？

items.sentenceEn: My little brother made a valentine for every child in his class.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟為班上每個小朋友都做了一張情人節卡片。

items.sentenceEn: Nomads in the desert live in tents and move with the seasons.
items.sentenceZh: 沙漠裡的遊牧民族住在帳篷裡，隨著季節遷移。

items.stemEn: She is very ____ and loves going to parties and meeting new people.
items.stemZh: 她很愛交際，喜歡參加派對、認識新朋友。

items.stemEn: My older sister's husband is my ____, and we get along well.
items.stemZh: 我姊姊的丈夫是我的姊夫，我們相處得很好。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my sister married a man from a small island, and I visited his family for the first time. My new brother-in-law is very sociable, and the islanders welcomed us with a big dinner. His grandmother, a quiet woman whom everyone calls Mrs. Lu, told us about old customs. Long ago, she said, families on the island prepared a dowry of cloth and pots for their daughters. She also talked about filial duty: young people there still visit their parents every weekend. I enjoyed the trip tremendously and promised to visit again soon.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我的姊妹嫁給一位來自小島的男人，我第一次去拜訪他的家人。我姊妹的新婚丈夫很愛交際，島民們用一頓豐盛的晚餐歡迎我們。他的奶奶是一位安靜的婦人，大家都叫她呂女士，她跟我們講了一些老習俗。她說，很久以前，島上的人家會為女兒準備布料和鍋子當嫁妝。她也談到孝道：那裡的年輕人至今仍然每個週末都回去看父母。我非常喜歡這趟旅行，也答應很快會再去。

questions.questionZh: 作者姊妹的新婚丈夫是什麼樣的人？
奶奶說島上的年輕人現在仍會做什麼？
options: 每天清晨一起出海捕魚

items.promptZh: 孝順父母是一種重要的美德。
referenceEn: Showing filial respect to your parents is an important virtue.
Filial love for one's parents is an important virtue.
rubricZh: filial 是形容詞（例如 filial piety、filial respect、filial love、filial duty）

items.promptZh: 我們的貓很愛和人親近，一看到客人就會走過去。
referenceEn: Our cat is very sociable and always walks over to visitors.
Our cat is so sociable that it goes up to every guest it sees.
rubricZh: sociable 是形容詞，表示「愛和人親近、合群的」（例如 is very sociable 等）
「一看到客人就走過去」可寫，例如 walks over to visitors、goes up to every guest 等
動物可用 it 指稱；寫 he、she 也不扣分
